topics.description: A massive fraud scandal involving child care programs in Minnesota has led to a surge in investigations and political fallout. The scandal has implicated several high-ranking officials and has raised concerns about the state's oversight of these programs.

A new Senate bill aims to crack down on 'runaway fraud' in child care programs, similar to the scandal in Minnesota. The bill seeks to force scammers to repay taxpayers and prevent similar fraud in the future.
